messages:
kia: Observed a small bucket of fncall responses with no tool_call and `validation` missing. console shows fallback but nothing in reject dashboards.
omar: can you paste an anonymized proxy record?
kia: snippet:
```
{"request_id":"r-5555","model":"redwood-rt-7b","resp":{"text":"...","tool_call":null},"validation":null
}
```
no reason field at all.
rebecca: we intentionally nulled validation for soft failures to avoid billing, but this kills observability and misattributes routing/quota.
laura: proposed fix: always attach a tiny validation envelope for soft rejects: {status:\"soft_reject\",code:\"enum_mismatch\",billing_exempt:true}. Keep billing semantics but surface telemetry.
omar: add metric `fncall.validation.silent_rejects_total{env,route,model}` and emit an audit line `AUDIT fncall soft_reject r-5555 reason=enum_mismatch` so logs and metrics can ingest.
rebecca: router change: treat `validation.status==\"soft_reject\"` as a distinct route tag `soft_reject` so quotas/SLAs aren't credited to degen fallback. Backcompat: if validation absent, keep old behavior for now.
laura: UI: collapsed per-route badge labeled "soft rejects" with sampled ids. Link to raw request. Feature-flag it to avoid noise.
kia: I'll open the proxy PR to attach canonicalized code (snake_case) and `billing_exempt:true`. Omar, can you own metric + audit forwarder?
omar: yep. I'll also update logging regex to accept hyphen/underscore variants until we canonicalize.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: started staging deploy (id s-1815) for proxy envelope change by kia  running health checks.
rebecca: tests: unit for canonicalizer + router path, integration to assert metric increments and audit parsing. I'll add them.
kia: timeline: aim to land proxy + metrics in 48h, gate console behind FF and roll in a week. Reopen thread with canary results. :thumbsup:
